On MuSiQue-Ans, the C-only model scores **53.4 answer F1 and 50.0 support F1** on the validation set (Table 4, p. 10).

- **Test set:** It scores 53.7 answer F1 and 50.0 support F1 (Table 5, p. 10). The paper reports test numbers in Table 5 and validation numbers everywhere else (p. 10).
- **How it works:** The C-only model sees only the context and gets an empty question. It is a Longformer-Large End2End model (p. 10).
- **Interpretation:** On HotpotQA and 2WikiMultihopQA, this model identifies supporting paragraphs well without the question (67.6 and 92.0 support F1). On MuSiQue-Ans it "fails" (p. 10).
- **Distractor effect:** The 53.4 / 50.0 result comes from the final setup of 20 paragraphs with positive distractors. With 20 distractors drawn from full Wikipedia instead, the C-only model would have reached 66.4 support F1 (Table 7, p. 12).
- **MuSiQue-Full (for comparison):** The C-only model scores 51.6 answer+sufficiency and 51.1 support+sufficiency (Table 5, p. 10).
